entities.name: Pantlaza
entities.description: A raptor of the Sun Empire on Ixalan, companion of Huatli and a leader among dinosaurs.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: Warrior-poet of the Sun Empire, Pantlaza's partner.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: City whose opening in 4560 AR led Pantlaza to Huatli.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion in 4562 in which Pantlaza fought.

entities.name: Quintorius Kand
entities.description: Joined the expedition to Ixalan's Core.

entities.name: Vito Quijano de Pasamonte
entities.description: Transformed vampire killed by Huatli with Pantlaza's help.

events.summary: After Orazca opened in 4560 AR Pantlaza pledged service and loyalty to Huatli as her packmate.
events.quote: Pantlaza chose Huatli as a packmate

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Pantlaza served as vanguard with his raptor company.
events.quote: acting as a vanguard to harry, flank, and disrupt Phyrexian columns

events.summary: Pantlaza joined an expedition to Ixalan's Core and helped Huatli kill Vito Quijano de Pasamonte.
events.quote: He helped Huatli to kill the transformed vampire Vito Quijano de Pasamonte

relations.quote: they work together as equals to lead humans and dinosaurs in battle and toward peace
